title: Hungry for Death: Destroy All Monsters

publisher.name: Boston University Art Gallery / An Art Service

description.main: Catalogue of the touring Destroy All Monsters exhibition, edited by Cary Loren and James Hoff, with essays by Byron Coley and Branden W. Joseph and a bound-in CD.
description.extended:
The catalogue for Hungry for Death: Destroy All Monsters, a touring exhibition on the art and music collective formed in Ann Arbor, Michigan, in the 1970s.

Compiled by Cary Loren and edited with James Hoff, the book has essays by Byron Coley and Branden W. Joseph, a Destroy All Monsters discography, and photographs, flyers, drawings and notes. A CD of demos, practice tapes and live recordings, Get Out of My Bedroom!, is bound into the back. The Boston University Art Gallery published it for the show there, 15 November to 22 December 2011.

The first lineup was Mike Kelley, Jim Shaw and Niagara, art students at the University of Michigan, with the filmmaker Cary Loren. The exhibition began at Printed Matter in New York in 2009, curated by Hoff and Loren, and went on to St. Louis, Oslo, London, Rome, Lausanne, Athens and Paris before reaching Boston.
